apihelp-query+pxpackages-extended-descri: Installed packages: pending is true while page jobs of the package are queued or claimed. jobs has the counts queued, claimed (running, or failed and waiting to be released for a retry) and failed (all attempts used and the claim older than the claim TTL). A client treats an install or update as finished when pending is false, and as complete only when failed is also 0. A failure on the last attempt is reported as claimed for up to the claim TTL of the job type. pending and jobs are null, with a warning, when the queue of the job type is not a database queue. pxpackagejobs.unattributed counts jobs without a package ID (queued before this was recorded), which are in no package count. With a claim TTL of 0 core never releases claimed jobs, so a claimed job stays claimed until it is pruned, and failed then only means that all attempts are used. Limits: between saving the package and queuing its jobs, pending can still be false. Jobs of an uninstalled package keep running and count under the same ID after a reinstall. One wiki per job table is assumed. Counting reads all job rows of the Page Exchange job type once per request, but only for installed packages.
pageexchange-jobstateunknown: The state of the page jobs is unknown because the job queue of Page Exchange is not a database queue, or it could not be read.
pageexchange-package-invaliddata: The stored package data of this package could not be read.
pageexchange-package-jobsunfinished: Page creation is not finished: {{PLURAL:$1|$1 job is|$1 jobs are}} queued and {{PLURAL:$2|$2 job is|$2 jobs are}} in progress or waiting for a retry.
pageexchange-package-jobsfailed: {{PLURAL:$1|$1 page job|$1 page jobs}} of this package failed.
